author: Elastic
rule.description:
Identifies a successful RC4-HMAC Kerberos service ticket request for a requester and service pair that has not been
observed during the previous 7 days. A newly observed requester-to-service relationship involving an RC4-encrypted
ticket may indicate Kerberoasting.
false_positives:
First-time or infrequent access to legacy services, cross-platform integrations, and inter-domain trust activity may
    legitimately establish a new requester-to-service relationship using RC4 encryption.
rule.name: Newly Observed RC4 Kerberos Service Ticket Request
rule.setup:
## Setup

Audit Kerberos Service Ticket Operations must be enabled to generate the events used by this rule.
Setup instructions: https://ela.st/audit-kerberos-service-ticket-operations
tags: Data Source: Windows Security Event Logs
rule.query:
host.os.type:windows and event.category:authentication and event.code:4769 and
  winlog.event_data.Status:0x0 and winlog.event_data.TicketEncryptionType:0x17 and
  winlog.event_data.TargetUserName:* and
  winlog.event_data.ServiceName:(* and not (krbtgt or *$)) and
  not (winlog.event_data.TargetUserName:*$@* and source.ip:(127.0.0.0/8 or "::1"))
